source_snapshot.procedure: Enable amdgpu RAS, query device0/block2, then inject `-d 0 -b 2 -s 0 -t 2`; however, the prose calls the target block0 UMC at address0x800 while the literal command targets block2 and omits the address.
source_snapshot.criteria: Requires injection success, an AMDGPU hardware-error message and a nonzero value from `-d 0 -b 2 -q 1`, but labels that block2 result a UMC error count.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; warns that the exact FAE-supplied GFX injection target is required, but does not reconcile the block, fault family, address or counter-domain contradictions.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED/CHANGED; refuses to choose GFX versus UMC or invent the missing address and counter oracle.

old_problem: The source mixes a GFX title and block2 command/query with UMC block0/address0x800 prose and a UMC-named counter criterion. The prior review correctly found that an executable fault domain and authoritative oracle cannot be selected safely.
disposition_reason: ED-16 forbids error injection without an approved tool, isolated target and recovery, while ED-15 forbids a PASS oracle without an authoritative expected result. ED-19/ED-20 require this identity to remain distinct rather than borrowing the adjacent coherent UMC or GFX-poison variants. The contradiction concerns the core command semantics, not a parameter that ED-03 can safely defer.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row455 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3044 and next formal queue row456/history3045.
The title and literal `-b 2` operations indicate GFX, while the narrative explicitly says block0 UMC at address0x800; the literal injection omits `-a 0x800`.
The criterion calls the block2 query a UMC counter, so even a successful command cannot be attributed to the intended fault family without a vendor mapping.
The adjacent row456 type8 GFX poison CPER test and rows452-454 coherent UMC tests are different coverage and cannot repair or replace this correctable-in-band identity.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row456 and verified its manifest identity; no driver load, error injection, query, reset, log clearing or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: AMD GFX correctable in-band injection — blocked pending coherent vendor tuple and oracle
test_case.purpose: Preserve the intended standalone GFX-correctable coverage while preventing execution until AMD/FAE resolves whether the case is GFX block2 or UMC block0 and publishes the exact tuple, counter domain and event oracle.
required_package: AMD/FAE corrected source or signed mapping for GFX versus UMC and block2 versus block0
Approved amdgpuras release/checksum with subtype0/type2/address semantics
Immutable GPU/card/serial/UUID/BDF/OAM identity on a dedicated idle SUT
Authoritative counter and correctable dmesg/SEL/CPER field oracle
One-shot abort and OOB recovery plan
test_case.test_command: DO NOT EXECUTE the source injection. After an approved correction, preserve counters/logs, bind the immutable GPU identity, validate the exact block/subtype/type/address tuple against the pinned amdgpuras release, obtain one-shot authorization, run exactly once, query only the approved same-domain counter, correlate the specified correctable event and perform the approved health/recovery checks. Never infer `-a 0x800`, substitute an adjacent tuple or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Not yet authoritatively defined. AMD/FAE must specify the intended fault domain, exact command, attributable counter delta and correctable event fields before any PASS/FAIL result is possible.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: BLOCKED. Neither command success nor a stale/nonzero block2 value can pass while the source calls the target both GFX and UMC and disagrees on block/address. PASS becomes available only after the corrected tuple and matching counter/event oracle are approved and evidenced.
safety_gate: No injection, module lifecycle change, reset, log clearing or substitute command under the contradictory source
Dedicated idle SUT, OOB access, immutable target and explicit single-injection authorization after correction
Abort on any tuple/version mismatch, severity escalation, GPU loss, hang, thermal or power issue
Preserve all evidence; no automatic retry
expected_evidence: Approved GFX-versus-UMC correction and pinned tool/driver/firmware semantics
Exact target map, tuple and address-applicability record
Preserved pre-state and same-domain counter baseline
Exact one-shot command/output/exit/time and specified correctable event fields
test_case.recovery: No executable recovery can be assumed for an undefined fault domain. AMD/FAE and platform owners must approve OOB abort/recovery for the corrected event before authorization; if any mismatch or instability occurs, stop, preserve evidence and do not retry.
